acceptanceCriteria: A01: An ordinary archived Work Item added by the exact current PR may project as awaiting_merge_close only when the pull-request event base/head and checked-out merge parents match and the Contract is introduced by that PR.
A02: Older unclosed archived Work Items, mismatched or malformed pull-request events, and non-PR checkouts remain blocking.
A03: The exact two-parent default-branch merge introducing the archive may pass the immediate transition; a later non-merge default-branch commit without a real close remains blocking.
A04: The three WI-1036 parity rows identify its archived Contract and accurately show archived-but-awaiting-merge status without claiming terminal completion.

A05: Focused governance and documentation checks pass; hosted CI passes on the exact corrective head and PR #997 head; integrate, clean, close the Task 8 lineage, then start Task 9 only when Runtime reports readyOnBase. Stop before release.
goal: Allow only an exact PR-introduced archive and its exact default-branch merge transition to await formal close; preserve fail-closed behavior for older archives, mismatched PR events, direct pushes, and later unclosed states.
intent: Repair the exact pre-merge CI lifecycle gate that blocks PR #997 because an archived Work Item cannot be formally closed before merge.
outOfScope: Skipping required checks or creating a formal close decision before integration.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Only a pull_request merge checkout whose event base and head match the merge parents and whose diff introduces this archive is treated as awaiting_merge_close.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: exact PR-introduced archive awaits formal close
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add an actual synthetic Git merge-ref fixture with exact event bindings; run the focused governance gate suite.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Older unclosed archives and malformed, mismatched, direct-push, or non-PR contexts remain blocking.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: older or mismatched archive remains blocked
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add negative fixture cases for old archive, wrong base/head, malformed event, direct push, and non-PR context; run the focused governance gate suite.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The exact two-parent default-branch merge introducing the archive can pass the immediate transition; a later non-merge commit without a real close is blocked.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: exact default-branch merge transition is bounded
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the existing and new real-Git transition fixtures, including the immediate merge and subsequent direct commit cases.

scenarioCoverage.expected: English, Chinese, and Japanese parity rows point to the archived WI-1036 Contract and state archived but awaiting PR merge without claiming terminal completion.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: tri-language parity describes archived awaiting-merge state
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Update and inspect all three parity rows, then run bash tests/docs/documentation_acceptance.sh.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Focused gate and documentation checks pass locally; hosted CI passes for the corrective head and PR #997 before integration.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: focused and hosted verification protects the exact change
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the declared focused checks and require hosted CI on exact corrective and PR #997 heads; do not release.
